title: 3 Techniques to Stop Overthinking - Part 2
description:
JUMP TO THE SOLUTION OF THE SPECIFIC TYPE OF OVERTHINKING YOU ARE EXPERIENCING - FUTURE, PRESENT, PAST. BUT IF YOU ARE CURIOUS AND WANT TO PREPARE YOURSELF FOR ANY STYLE OF OVERTHINKING YOU CAN WATCH THE FULL VIDEO :) 

✍🏻 A little note before I give you the timestamps:

Curious and comprehensive. We explore personal development in a manner where you will walk away with insightful and actionable perspective, that you will employ in your life and allow you to live audaciously in the real world. 

My primary objective with all my work is that YOU, my audience, who are watching this video become self-aware and transform their relationship with themselves and the world. To create the best possible version of their life and enjoy living in it. 

I am a personal development coach with 5000+ hours of teaching experience. 

Even though I am not a parent yet, out of the Individual sessions, private advisory, group workshops or content, guest lectures and talks, if you asked me to pick a favourite format of work, I believe it would be a similar experience when asked to pick a favourite child. Confusing and Excruciating :) 

I hope to bleed onto you the same love for the subject as I experience in my hours of study and work. And walk your path of transformation with you. Thank you for being here and keep watching! 

-Ipsita
